title: Cartesian closedness of the category of real-valued sets, II
summary: Let $[0,1]_*$ be the unit interval $[0,1]$ equipped with a left-continuous t-norm $*$. We prove that $[0,1]_*\text{-}\mathbf{Set}$ is cartesian closed if and only if $*$ is the minimum t-norm. This extends the classification for continuous t-norms established in the first part of this work to the whole left-continuous setting.
